description: Cozy Corner lot - corner to corner.   Wonderful wooded lot with single story warm home.   Vaulted ceilings.   3 dedicated fenced areas for children's play, canine fun and safety.  Sliders off family room for inside/outside activities in fully enclosed west yard.  Majestic oaks for shade and historic beauty.  Breakfast bar open to family room with fireplace.   Formal entry.   Former large living room has been temporarily converted to bedroom plus nursery.  (4th).  Full laundry room off kitchen backing up to main bedroom bath for easy ensuite expansion.  Office space is attached to the primary suite with it's high ceilings and direct access to another flat patio.  Lots of parking and lawn area off the street.   Residence is in need of updating.  Monte Nido is an eclectic and close in community, adjacent to both Malibu and Calabasas/Agoura and 101 Fwy.   Annual 4th of July festival is legendary.  Exceptional school district.   Bring your dreams and make it your own.
